messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Pager: smart-routing fallback flapping detected for service=redwood-api, customer=acme-inc, impacted-regions: eu-west-1 -> fallback -> us-east-1 loop. AlertID: fb-1798001234. Links: https://alerts.internal/FB-1798001234
oncall-alex: I’m on it. Paging @sre-rita and @eng-runtime-josh. Seen any similar patterns in the last 24h?
eng-runtime-josh: saw increased fallback counts starting ~1797999000, matches KV cache misses on variant key. Possibly cache keys not including region in the new routing change.
sre-rita: oncall here, taking pager. Quick assessment: users in eu are being routed to us-east, then failing KV prefix check, which causes fallback to a different compatible variant, then back. That creates repeated routing decisions => flapping. Customer impact: increased latency and some 502s for long-chat sessions.
oncall-alex: impact confirmed by APM traces: request path shows routing->variant-a (eu) miss -> route->variant-b (us) hit -> KV prefix eviction -> repeat. Examples in logs: `route_id=svc-123 path=/v1/chat latency=1100ms fallback=true kv_key=variant:a`
ml-infra-sam: I can reproduce in staging by setting `routing.fallback.enabled=true` + enabling prefix mapping that omits region. Likely bug in last rollout (commit a3f2c4) that changed cache key composition.
eng-runtime-josh: immediate mitigation idea: disable fallback policy for acme-inc and force region affinity for requests from eu-west-1. That should stop cross-region traffic and break the loop. Deploy config change using `rbac` flag in routing plane.
product-elaine: need a quick customer impact note for CS if we pause fallback. @cs-maya can you standby to message Acme with ETA?
cs-maya: standby. If we can give a 30m mitigation estimate I’ll notify them with details and offer status updates every 30m.
sre-rita: plan: 1) apply emergency routing override to pin acme-inc -> eu-west-1 primary 2) rollback the cache key change in routing service (revert a3f2c4) to dev-canary 3) flush affected KV prefixes for variant keys in eu cluster 4) monitor for flapping for 30m.
oncall-alex: executing step 1 now. Command: `curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/override -d '{"customer":"acme-inc","region":"eu-west-1","mode":"pin"}'` (will follow up with deploy id).
incident-bot: deploy-trigger: override-1798001240 started by oncall-alex.
oncall-alex: override applied. Early metrics: cross-region egress for acme-inc down 92% in the first 2 mins. Latency ~ back to baseline for new incoming sessions.
eng-runtime-josh: starting rollback of cache-key change to dev-canary. Patch: revert commit a3f2c4 and re-enable `cache.key = model+region+variant` in routing service. Snippet:
```
# routing config snippet
cache:
  key_components:
    - model_id
    - region // ensure region included
    - variant_id
```
eng-runtime-josh: rollback pushed to canary (canary-id=cb-789). Monitoring logs for mismatched keys.
ml-infra-sam: clearing KV prefixes on eu clusters: `redis-cli --scan --pattern "acme-inc:*:variant:*" | xargs -L 100 redis-cli del` — running with dry-run first, then actually deleting.
sre-rita: note: prefer to flush only keys that were created since rollout timestamp 1797998000 to avoid collateral eviction. Use `SCAN` with `TYPE` filters.
oncall-alex: flushing targeted keys now.
incident-bot: action-complete: override applied, rollback deployed to canary, kv-flush started.
eng-runtime-josh: canary looks good, variant mismatches drop to negligible. No new fallback loops in canary traces. I'll promote the rollback to prod after 10m if stable.
sre-rita: handing off to next on-call @sre-rita (staying) -> actually I’ll hand off to @oncall-b-week after 30m. Next oncall, pickup notes: root cause likely missing region in cache key due to a runtime config change; follow up actions required: 1) revert in main branch 2) add unit/integration tests that cover cache-key composition and routing fallback loops 3) run chaos test for region fallback.
cs-maya: I messaged Acme with an update: "We detected transient routing flapping causing elevated latency. We’ve applied a routing override and developer rollback; we expect service to be stable. Will provide another update in 30m"
product-elaine: thanks, +1 on postmortem and customer blameless summary.
eng-runtime-josh: promoted rollback to prod (deploy-id=prod-452). Monitor window begins.
incident-bot: incident status: mitigated. start_close_timer=30m.
sre-rita: closing notes: timeline - 1797999000 (first increase) -> 1798001234 (pager) -> 1798001240 override -> 1798001305 rollback canary -> 1798001500 prod rollback -> 1798001600 mitigation stable. Post-incident actions: (A) add integration test for cache key composition, (B) add metric alert for fallback-rate > 5% sustained, (C) update runbook to include targeted KV flush steps and safeguards.
oncall-alex: adding followup tickets now.
cs-maya: will schedule customer follow-up call if they report any residual issues.
product-elaine: thanks everyone. If no objections I’ll convert this thread to postmortem draft. :thumbsup:
